Element: Bloom. VFX: touches the ground (Legendary), six layers in Effects.luau: four pink
petals orbit the crown half a stud out, a little flower of four yellow petals pops in each
footprint every 2.4 s, a warm gold light pulses over the antlers, a green leaf drifts off its
back every so often, and on the flourish the antlers shed a burst of eighteen pink petals while
a pink ring rolls out over the ground from its hooves. The flourish (every 12 s) is a spring
blessing: a hop and a full turn, the flower crown popping, the antler trees shaking, the ears
